# CORE-INT-02

**Is the context-map relationship of every cross-context connector stated, and is it the right one?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [Core architecture lens](core.md) 0.6.0 |
| Area | INT: Interfaces and contracts |
| Default severity | minor |
| Decided by | A tool checks presence; a reviewer judges |
| Applies when | at least one connector has both ends with part_of, in different bounded contexts |
| Reads | `connectors.context_relationship` |

## Rule

Every connector whose ends both have part_of, and differ, has context_relationship. An end with no part_of is outside the design's contexts, and its connectors are judged by CORE-INT-01 instead.

## Sources

- Eric Evans, Domain-Driven Design (`evans`)
- Vlad Khononov, Balancing Coupling in Software Design (2024) (`khononov`)
